contact.formNote: Submitting this form does not create an attorney-client relationship.

faq.question: What happens after I reach out?
faq.answer: We review your note and respond within two business days. If it seems like a good fit, we will schedule an introductory call.

faq.question: Do you work with individuals and businesses?
faq.answer: Yes. Our practice supports founders, established companies, families, and individuals with significant personal or business decisions.

faq.question: Where are you based?
faq.answer: Our office is in New York, and we work with clients across the United States and internationally when the matter calls for it.
